story.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs

draft:
Demis Hassabis stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind marks a significant shift in AI leadership. 
I've been following DeepMind's work and I think this change will impact their research agenda. 
Key areas like AlphaFold and reinforcement learning may see new directions. 
What does this mean for the future of AI innovation at Google?
